message.content: Recent video reconstruction from sparse event streams often suffers from blurred textures and poor long-term stability, while few-step autoregressive video generation accumulates errors and weakens motion dynamics over extended sequences. Existing regression and generative methods struggle to maintain high-quality, coherent video over long horizons. New approaches incorporate video diffusion priors and on-policy self-distillation to mitigate these temporal artifacts and enhance visual fidelity.
